values.trigger: Automatically after I add a batch of original wildlife photos, with a weekly process in mind.
values.result: Suggested carousel packs ready for phone review, with sensible grouping, crops, resized exports, captions or metadata, and a map end card only when location is available and safe. Keep originals untouched.
values.sources: The original photo files, the attached photo metadata CSV, sample folders, and phone review. Some photos have GPS, some do not; some are blurry or duplicates.
values.role: I review the suggested packs and approve before sharing. Flag blurry, duplicate, uncertain crop, missing-location, and privacy cases for review instead of requiring manual preparation or inventing details.
